name: Ingi ~Retsujou ni Torawareta Junshin~
original_name: 淫戯～劣情に囚われた純心～
source:
Main character enjoys school life and spending time with his female childhood friend. But as conscious of the opposite sex comes he falls in love. Sex is what lovers do. Protagonist does not recognize sex without love, but it's a way to express feelings...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公享受着校园生活，也经常与青梅竹马的女孩共度时光。然而随着对异性的意识萌芽，他逐渐爱上了她。性爱是恋人之间会做的事。主人公无法接受没有爱的性行为，却也认为这是传达心意的一种方式……
